moveAboveThisDoc: Move current doc {currentDoc} above this doc
moveBelowThisDoc: Move current doc {currentDoc} below this doc
moveToSameLevel: Move current doc {currentDoc} to this doc's level
moveToThisDoc: Move current doc {currentDoc} as a child of this doc
moveToThisNotebook: Move current doc {currentDoc} to this notebook
expandDocTreeAfterMoveDoc: Expand document tree after moving document
moveDocPosition: Position of moved doc in the target list
moveDocPositionDesc: Only applies when the target list uses custom sort; otherwise the position is determined by the sort rule
moveDocPositionFollow: Follow SiYuan's "Create new docs at the top" setting
getDocsByPathFailed: Failed to get documents by path
sortModeChanged: The target list sort mode has changed, please try again
